c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Academy's Research Institutes
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the research institutes of the Academy of Sciences were reorganised in 2019 and how the change was judged.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.prompt: Say what the government and the leaders of the Academy said about the change, naming the source of each view.
cues: Give the government's reason
Give the view of the Academy's leaders
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.target: A kormány indoklása szerint a változtatás a hatékonyabb működést szolgálta. Az Akadémia vezetése szerint viszont a javaslat sértette az akadémiai autonómiát.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.english: According to the government's reasoning, the change served more efficient operation. According to the Academy's leadership, however, the proposal violated academic autonomy.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.canDo: I can describe how the research institutes of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences were reorganised in 2018–2023, with dates (*kutatóhálózat, autonómia, finanszírozás*).

c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Higher Education Act of 2017
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked about the higher education act of 2017 and Central European University.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.prompt: Say what condition the act set for a foreign university and what the Court of Justice found in 2020.
cues: Give the condition of the act
Give the date and the finding of the Court of Justice
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.target: A külföldi egyetem tovább működhetett, feltéve, hogy a két ország kormánya egyezményt kötött. Az Európai Unió Bírósága 2020. október 6-án kimondta, hogy a magyar szabályozás nem egyeztethető össze az uniós joggal.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.english: The foreign university could go on operating, provided that the governments of the two countries concluded an agreement. On 6 October 2020 the Court of Justice of the European Union held that the Hungarian regulation was not compatible with EU law.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.canDo: I can describe the higher education act of 2017 and the dispute about Central European University, with dates (*akkreditáció, egyezmény, kötelezettségszegési eljárás*).

c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Foundation Model
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the government and its critics argued about the university foundations.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.prompt: Say what the government and the critics argued, with minél … annál.
cues: Give the government's argument about funding
Give the critics' argument about the board and the senate
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.target: A kormány szerint minél stabilabb volt a forrás, annál rugalmasabban gazdálkodhattak az egyetemek. A bírálók szerint minél nagyobb lett a kuratórium szerepe, annál kisebb lett a szenátusé.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.english: According to the government, the more stable the funding was, the more flexibly the universities could manage. According to the critics, the greater the role of the board became, the smaller that of the senate became.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.canDo: I can describe how state universities came under foundations from 2019, with dates (*kuratórium, szenátus, fenntartó*).

c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Council Decision of 2022
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what followed from the Council's decision of December 2022.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.prompt: Say what the Council decided, what followed from it, and how the government judged it.
cues: Say what followed for the foundation universities
Give the government's view
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.target: A Tanács 2022 decemberében határozatot hozott, és emiatt az alapítványi egyetemek nem köthettek új támogatási megállapodásokat. A kormány szerint az intézkedés politikai indíttatású volt.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.english: In December 2022 the Council took a decision, and because of this the foundation universities could not conclude new grant agreements. According to the government the measure was politically motivated.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.canDo: I can describe the dispute about EU funding for the foundation universities in 2022–2025, with dates (*összeférhetetlenség, kötelezettségvállalás, hallgatói mobilitás*).

c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Election of 2026
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the debate on higher education stood before the election of 2026 and how the election ended.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.prompt: Set the two views against each other, then give the result of the election of 12 April 2026.
cues: Contrast the government's view with the critics' view
Give the result of the election
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.target: A kormány szerint az alapítványi modell stabil forrást adott, a bírálók szerint viszont csökkent az egyetemek autonómiája. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt a 199 mandátumból 141-et szerzett.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.english: According to the government the foundation model gave stable funding, but according to the critics the autonomy of the universities declined. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza Party won 141 of the 199 seats.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.canDo: I can sum up the debate on higher education and research before the election of 2026 and the change of government, with dates (*választás, mandátum, miniszterelnök*).

c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Higher Education and Research in Summary
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the period from 2017 to 2026.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the period briefly, with years and sources.
cues: Mention the higher education act of 2017
Mention the research network of 2019 and the critics' view
Mention the election of the prime minister in 2026
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.target: 2017-ben az Országgyűlés módosította a felsőoktatási törvényt. 2019-ben létrejött az Eötvös Loránd Kutatási Hálózat, a bírálók szerint viszont csökkent az Akadémia autonómiája. 2026. május 9-én az Országgyűlés Magyar Pétert választotta miniszterelnökké.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.english: In 2017 the National Assembly amended the higher education act. In 2019 the Eötvös Loránd Research Network was created, but according to the critics the Academy's autonomy declined. On 9 May 2026 the National Assembly elected Péter Magyar prime minister.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the changes at the Academy of Sciences, at Central European University and in the universities between 2017 and 2026, with years and sources.

c1-megfigyeles-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Pegasus Reports of 2021
c1-megfigyeles-01.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what the company and the Hungarian government said when the Pegasus reports came out in 2021.
c1-megfigyeles-01.prompt: Say what the NSO Group and the Hungarian government said, using reported speech.
cues: Say what the NSO Group stated about who gets the programme
Say what the government said about the secret services
c1-megfigyeles-01.target: Az NSO Group azt közölte, hogy a programot csak állami szerveknek adja el. A magyar kormány azt mondta, hogy a titkosszolgálatok a törvényi keretek között működtek.
c1-megfigyeles-01.english: The NSO Group stated that it sells the programme only to state bodies. The Hungarian government said that the secret services had operated within the legal framework.
c1-megfigyeles-01.canDo: I can describe how the Pegasus reports of 2021 came out and what the Hungarian government said about them, with dates (*kémszoftver, titkosszolgálat, megfigyelés*).

c1-megfigyeles-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Authorising Surveillance
c1-megfigyeles-02.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how covert surveillance was authorised and what the European Court of Human Rights found.
c1-megfigyeles-02.prompt: Say what the services had to do, and what the Court found in 2016.
cues: Say what the services had to do before a covert surveillance
Give the year and the finding of the Court
c1-megfigyeles-02.target: A szolgálatok kötelesek voltak engedélyt kérni az igazságügyi minisztertől. Az Emberi Jogok Európai Bírósága 2016-ban megállapította, hogy a szabályozás nem nyújtott elegendő garanciát a visszaélések ellen.
c1-megfigyeles-02.english: The services had to ask the minister of justice for permission. In 2016 the European Court of Human Rights found that the regulation did not offer sufficient guarantees against abuse.
c1-megfigyeles-02.canDo: I can describe how covert surveillance was authorised and what the European Court of Human Rights found in 2016, with dates (*engedélyezés, garancia, magánélet*).

c1-megfigyeles-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Source Protection
c1-megfigyeles-03.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what the journalists and the government said about the effect of the surveillance on sources.
c1-megfigyeles-03.prompt: Say, with a hedge, what the organisations thought the surveillance did to sources, and what the government said.
cues: Say carefully what the surveillance probably did to sources
Say what the government said about the surveillance
c1-megfigyeles-03.target: A sajtószabadsággal foglalkozó szervezetek szerint a megfigyelés feltehetőleg elriasztotta a forrásokat. A kormány azt mondta, hogy a megfigyelések törvényesek voltak.
c1-megfigyeles-03.english: According to the organisations dealing with press freedom, the surveillance probably deterred sources. The government said that the surveillance had been lawful.
c1-megfigyeles-03.canDo: I can describe what source protection means and how journalists and the government judged the effect of the surveillance, with dates (*forrásvédelem, sajtószabadság, dermesztő hatás*).

c1-megfigyeles-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Committee Session
c1-megfigyeles-04.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what happened when the opposition called a session of the National Security Committee.
c1-megfigyeles-04.prompt: Say what happened to the committee although the opposition had called the session, and when the committee heard the heads of the services.
cues: Use a concession
Give the month and the year of the hearing
c1-megfigyeles-04.target: Annak ellenére, hogy az ellenzék kezdeményezte az ülést, a bizottság nem volt határozatképes. 2022 januárjában a bizottság meghallgatta a titkosszolgálatok vezetőit.
c1-megfigyeles-04.english: Although the opposition had called the session, the committee did not have a quorum. In January 2022 the committee heard the heads of the secret services.
c1-megfigyeles-04.canDo: I can describe how the Pegasus case was examined in the Hungarian parliament and in the European Parliament, with dates (*Nemzetbiztonsági Bizottság, határozatképes, vizsgálóbizottság*).

c1-megfigyeles-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Rules of Surveillance and the Election
c1-megfigyeles-05.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what the human rights organisations proposed and how the election of 2026 ended.
c1-megfigyeles-05.prompt: Say what the organisations proposed with a verbal noun, then give the result of the election of 12 April 2026.
cues: Say what the organisations proposed
Give the result of the election
c1-megfigyeles-05.target: A jogvédő szervezetek a titkos megfigyelés bírói engedélyezését javasolták. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt a 199 mandátumból 141-et szerzett.
c1-megfigyeles-05.english: The human rights organisations proposed the judicial authorisation of covert surveillance. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza Party won 141 of the 199 seats.
c1-megfigyeles-05.canDo: I can sum up the debate about the rules of covert surveillance before the election of 2026 and the change of government, with dates (*szabályozás, visszaélés, rendelet*).

c1-megfigyeles-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Pegasus Case in Summary
c1-megfigyeles-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the Pegasus case from 2021 to 2026.
c1-megfigyeles-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the case briefly, with years and sources.
cues: Say what the NSO Group stated
Mention the judgment of 2016
Mention the election of the prime minister in 2026
c1-megfigyeles-consolidation.target: Az NSO Group azt közölte, hogy a programot csak állami szerveknek adja el. Az Emberi Jogok Európai Bírósága 2016-ban megállapította, hogy a szabályozás nem nyújtott elegendő garanciát a visszaélések ellen. 2026. május 9-én az Országgyűlés Magyar Pétert választotta miniszterelnökké.
c1-megfigyeles-consolidation.english: The NSO Group stated that it sells the programme only to state bodies. In 2016 the European Court of Human Rights found that the regulation did not offer sufficient guarantees against abuse. On 9 May 2026 the National Assembly elected Péter Magyar prime minister.
c1-megfigyeles-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the Pegasus case between 2021 and 2026, with years and sources.

c1-magyarjovo-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Strike Rules of 2022
c1-magyarjovo-01.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the unions and the government judged the strike rules for teachers.
c1-magyarjovo-01.prompt: Say what the unions and what the government said about the decree of 2022, naming the source of each view.
cues: Give the unions' view
Give the government's view
c1-magyarjovo-01.target: A szakszervezetek szerint a rendelet korlátozta a sztrájkjogot. A kormány szerint viszont a diákok oktatásának biztosítását szolgálta.
c1-magyarjovo-01.english: According to the unions, the decree restricted the right to strike. According to the government, however, it served to ensure the education of the pupils.
c1-magyarjovo-01.canDo: I can describe the teachers' protests and strikes of 2022–2023, with dates (*pedagógus, szakszervezet, sztrájk, elégséges szolgáltatás*).

c1-magyarjovo-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Local Government Revenue in 2020
c1-magyarjovo-02.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what followed from the measures of 2020 for the finances of local governments.
c1-magyarjovo-02.prompt: Say what the government did and what followed from it, using emiatt.
cues: Say what the government gave to businesses
Say what followed for the local governments
c1-magyarjovo-02.target: A kormány 2020-ban kedvezményt adott a vállalkozásoknak, és emiatt csökkentek az önkormányzatok bevételei.
c1-magyarjovo-02.english: In 2020 the government gave businesses a reduction, and because of this the revenues of local governments fell.
c1-magyarjovo-02.canDo: I can describe the dispute about the finances of local governments in 2019–2023, with dates (*önkormányzat, bevétel, iparűzési adó*).

c1-magyarjovo-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Battery Factories
c1-magyarjovo-03.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the residents and the government argued about the battery factories.
c1-magyarjovo-03.prompt: Say what the residents and what the government argued, with minél … annál.
cues: Give the residents' argument about water
Give the government's argument about jobs
c1-magyarjovo-03.target: A lakók szerint minél nagyobb egy gyár, annál nagyobb a vízigénye. A kormány szerint minél több gyár épül, annál több munkahely jön létre.
c1-magyarjovo-03.english: According to the residents, the larger a factory is, the greater its water demand is. According to the government, the more factories are built, the more jobs are created.
c1-magyarjovo-03.canDo: I can describe the dispute about the battery factories, with places and dates (*akkumulátorgyár, kiemelt beruházás, közmeghallgatás*).

c1-magyarjovo-04.title: Communicative Challenge: EU Funds
c1-magyarjovo-04.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the government and the European Commission explained the withholding of EU funds.
c1-magyarjovo-04.prompt: Set the two explanations against each other with viszont.
cues: Give the government's explanation
Give the Commission's explanation
c1-magyarjovo-04.target: A kormány szerint a visszatartás politikai nyomásgyakorlás volt, a Bizottság viszont a jogállamisági aggályokkal indokolta.
c1-magyarjovo-04.english: According to the government the withholding was political pressure, but the Commission justified it with rule-of-law concerns.
c1-magyarjovo-04.canDo: I can describe the debate about the European Public Prosecutor's Office, EU funds and the election of 2022, with dates (*Európai Ügyészség, jogállamiság, civil szervezet*).

c1-magyarjovo-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Membership of the European Union
c1-magyarjovo-05.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked about Hungary's membership of the European Union and the disputes around it.
c1-magyarjovo-05.prompt: Say when Hungary became a member and what it did in 2024 despite the disputes.
cues: Give the date of joining
State the concession
c1-magyarjovo-05.target: Magyarország 2004. május 1-jén lett az Európai Unió tagja. A viták ellenére 2024 második felében betöltötte az Európai Unió Tanácsának soros elnökségét.
c1-magyarjovo-05.english: Hungary became a member of the European Union on 1 May 2004. Despite the disputes, in the second half of 2024 it held the rotating presidency of the Council of the European Union.
c1-magyarjovo-05.canDo: I can sum up Hungary's membership of the European Union and the debate before the election of 2026, with dates (*tagság, szuverenitás, elnökség*).

c1-magyarjovo-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Period in Summary
c1-magyarjovo-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the period from 2019 to 2026.
c1-magyarjovo-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the period briefly, with years and sources.
cues: Mention the teachers' strike rules and a view of them
Mention the election of 2026
c1-magyarjovo-consolidation.target: A szakszervezetek szerint a 2022-es rendelet korlátozta a sztrájkjogot, a kormány szerint viszont a diákok oktatását szolgálta. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt a 199 mandátumból 141-et szerzett.
c1-magyarjovo-consolidation.english: According to the unions the decree of 2022 restricted the right to strike, but according to the government it served the education of the pupils. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza Party won 141 of the 199 seats.
c1-magyarjovo-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the teachers' protests, the local government finances, the battery factories and the EU debate between 2019 and 2026, with years and sources.
